guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：LUMI 超級電腦架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: LUMI supercomputer architecture
guides.concept: 以LUMI 的 CPU/GPU 分割槽與高頻寬計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect lumi cpu/gpu partitions and high-bandwidth computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「分割槽目的」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「記憶體層次」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：主機記憶體與加速器 HBM 位置不同。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具陣列的分配與移轉。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「頻寬核算」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：訪問位元組應包含讀、寫及重複讀取。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「為玩具 stencil 列完整 bytes/FLOP。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「軟體環境」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：編譯器、ROCm 與數值庫版本影響行為。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「記錄玩具模型完整軟體清單。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「能效邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：能效需明確節點、機房與冷卻邊界。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較假想晶片能量與整機能量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
先觀察師傅的「科學交付」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：平臺名不取代版本、輸入與可重算結果。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「建立不需真實賬號的離線報告。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for partition purposes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for memory hierarchy. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Host memory and accelerator HBM have different locations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw allocation and transfer of toy arrays. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for bandwidth accounting. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Access bytes include reads, writes and repeated reads. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: List complete bytes per FLOP for a toy stencil. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for software environments. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Compiler, ROCm and numerical-library versions affect behavior. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record complete software for a toy model. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for energy scope. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Energy efficiency specifies node, facility and cooling boundaries. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare hypothetical chip and full-system energy. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific delivery. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Platform names do not replace versions, inputs and reproducible results. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Create an offline report requiring no real account. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「移植驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「同為 MI250X 系統即可原樣遷移所有配置。」為何不成立。
提交「科學交付」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「建立不需真實賬號的離線報告。」如何辨別它們。
提交「科學交付」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「完成課程表示已操作真實 LUMI。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for port acceptance; explain why this claim fails: All MI250X systems reuse every setting unchanged.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for scientific delivery; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for scientific delivery; explain why this claim fails: Completing this course means operating real LUMI.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：完成課程表示已操作真實 LUMI。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Completing this course means operating real LUMI. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
